cases.reason: GR3 defers its value to 'these general rules'. For arithmetic-expression-1 that is GR4 -> 7.2.5, which in 2002 PRESCRIBES standard arithmetic (each operation truncated to 32 significant digits); 2023 7.3.6.3 GR2 makes the mode implementor-defined, so the twin's witnesses (l1c05, constant_entry) show the 2023 implementor mode, not 2002 standard arithmetic. The LENGTH/BYTE-LENGTH half is the same requirement (2002 'variable-length data item' = group with a variable-table OCCURS = 2023 'occurs-depending group item'), and in 2002 it also reaches CD record items (probe const-cd.cob: KL=87 KB=7 at 2002, correct). Probe const-arith.cob at --std 2002: K1 = 1/3*3 -> 0 (correct), K2 = 2/3*3 -> 2 (2002 standard arithmetic gives 1.99...98 -> 1), K4 = 1234567890123456789012345678901/7*7 -> ...901 (2002 gives ...900.9 -> ...900). The compiler rounds each intermediate (the SDIDI / STANDARD-DECIMAL engine, kb/Work PB1592) instead of truncating each operation to 32 digits.

cases.reason: Communication-section reach the reader missed. The 2002 data division format and the 2002 communication section format both admit a constant-entry under a communication description entry (the bracket after communication-description-entry is {constant-entry | record-description-entry}...), so in 2002 GR2 also governs the class and category of a constant-name declared in the COMMUNICATION SECTION. 2023 has no communication section, and the twin's witnesses (cases/13.10-Constant/constant_entry, 7.3.11-DEFINE/pb1368_constant_from_compilation_variable) declare their constants in working-storage, so the 2023 row's evidence says nothing about that 2002 scope item. The reader's own GR3 row found the CD reach only through data-name-1/2 (a CD record named by LENGTH OF), not a constant entry written IN the communication section. Probe const-in-cd.cob: '01 KA CONSTANT AS "HELLO".' and '01 KN CONSTANT AS 123.' written after 'CD CI FOR INPUT'; at --std 2002 it compiles (COBOL0903 obsolescence warning only) and prints 'KA=HELLO KN=123' and 'NUMERIC-OK' (KA used as an alphanumeric literal in MOVE, KN as a numeric literal in MOVE and a relation): compiler correct; at --std 2023 refused COBOL0902 (section removed). Needs: a 2002 witness for a constant entry under a CD (this probe). The same reach covers every 13.9 rule (SR1-SR11, GR1-GR6), not only this one.
